specs.英文简介: The Kaftax Banco Perfect is a simple Bakelite camera with a telescoping lens barrel, made in France, c.1955While McKeown's states "circa 1955," [http://www.collectiongeven.com/piwigo/picture.php?/103/category/750 G.Even] gives 1948; [http://www.collection-appareils.fr/x/html/page_standard.php?id_appareil=264 Sylvain Halgand] has 1952-55.
